items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: And when Duke came back from Europe, I called him and asked him did he want me in the band. And then he told me yes, he said, 'You're going to take Claude Jones' place.'

ctx.x: And when Duke came back from Europe, I called him and asked him did he want me in the band. And then he told me yes, he said, 'You're going to take Claude Jones' place.' And I said, 'Oh, gee, I didn't want to do that,' you know, because, gee whiz, I mean Claude, you know --
